visual.general_description: Composite figure of nine labeled medical images (A to I) arranged in three rows: three echocardiogram panels labeled "Echo" (A to C), two cine cardiac MR panels labeled "Cine" and a 4D flow panel (D to F), and three MR panels labeled "T1WI", "T2WI" and "LGE" (G to I).
visual.detailed_description: Row one (A to C) shows grayscale echocardiogram sectors on black backgrounds, each with a yellow arrow and a white label box printing "Echo"; panel C has a color Doppler overlay. Row two shows two grayscale cine MR images (D and E) with yellow arrows, E also with a blue arrowhead, labeled "Cine", and a color-coded 4D flow rendering (F) with a scale printed "80 cm/s" to "0 cm/s". Row three shows three grayscale MR images (G to I), each with a yellow arrow and a label box printing "T1WI", "T2WI" and "LGE". Panel letters A to I are printed at the top left of each panel. No patient name, date or measurement values are printed.

panels.general_description: Grayscale echocardiogram sector image with a yellow arrow at an echogenic structure near the apex.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A is a grayscale ultrasound sector image on a black background, with the letter A at the top left. A yellow arrow at the upper centre points to a brighter, echogenic structure near the narrow top of the sector; a dark chamber lies below it and brighter tissue forms the lower left and right walls. A white label box at the bottom left prints "Echo". A small round icon with a letter is at the top centre, and a ruler with a green dot and the printed text "X2" is at the right.
